text:
anna-w: FYI — starting staged rollout for runtime v2.3-kernel at 23:10 UTC. This tweaks KV eviction heuristic and adds a router header flag. Proposal: API/console pinned to v2.2 for wave1, runtime -> v2.3-canary.
samir: Got it. Canary health gates?
anna-w: Gates: 5xx rate < 0.1%, p50 latency delta < 10ms, kv-miss-rate change < 0.5%. Use header X-RW-Test=runtime-canary for canary traffic.
maria: I'll pin the console route and freeze release note edits. Linking draft: https://go/release/notes/176755-rt-kernel (do not merge until green) :lock:
igor: Router note: when flipping header routing keep fallback path intact for 10m and watch router.header.swap.failures. If that metric moves, immediate rollback.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot triggered: wave1 -> runtime:v2.3-canary at 2026-03-21T23:10:00Z (10% traffic). Notifying on-call.
leah: On-call acked. I'll run a smoke set against API endpoints that exercise prefix caching + KV access.
maria: Console pinned to v2.2, API pinned to v2.2. Documented in release ticket.
anna-w: Rollback triggers: kv-miss-rate > 0.5% for 2 consecutive 1m buckets OR router.header.swap.failures > 1% in 5m.
samir: Do we have a runtime fallback artifact to flip to v2.2 quickly?
igor: Yes. Rollback steps for operators: 1) push runtime v2.2 pin, 2) revert router header flag, 3) unpin console/api after stability, 4) staged traffic drain. Commands: 
```
# rollback runtime
rzctl deploy set runtime --version v2.2 --zone=all --priority=high
rzctl router flip-header --flag=disable-runtime-canary
```
maria: Also adding manual CS hold for customer-facing announcements until wave1 green.
leah: Monitoring dashboards rt-kernel/kv-evictions and router/header-swap. Will report if odd. :eyes:
deploy-bot: wave1 complete: 10% steady for 6m. p50 +6ms, 5xx 0.03%, kv-miss +0.12% => PASS. Proceeding to wave2 (33%).
anna-w: Start wave2. Keep API/console pins. Observe window 15m.
igor: Router will ramp header on north-south with fallback for 10m after each step.
samir: Note for release notes: call out KV eviction tuning and backward-compatible router header; include rollback playbook snippet.
maria: Release note draft updated and ticket linked.
leah: Wave2 at 33% started. Monitoring.
deploy-bot: wave2 33% for 10m -> health gates green. No anomalies in router.header.swap.failures.
leah: Small uptick in long-tail latency on pool-eta-3, investigating.
anna-w: If isolated to one pool, cordon that pool and continue; if cross-pool, immediate rollback. @igor prepare cordon play.
igor: Cordon command: `rzctl node cordon --pool=pool-eta-3`. If cordon doesn't reduce errors in 5m, escalate to rollback.
leah: Cordon executed; error rate on pool-eta-3 back to baseline. Continuing ramp.
deploy-bot: wave3 ramp -> 100% (gradual over 10m). Final observe window 20m.
maria: After stable 20m, I'll unpin console/api and merge release note, then send customer blurb.
samir: Reminder: tag canary flags in config repo and add infra note about kv threshold change.
anna-w: Through the 20m stable window with no regressions. Unpinning console/api and starting post-rollout validations.
maria: Release notes merged. Marking release ticket done-pending-monitoring.
igor: Opening follow-up: telemetry improvement for router.header.swap metric granularity.
leah: Retrospect: add a synthetic that exercises cold-KV misses before future kernel flips. :+1:
deploy-bot: rollout complete -> runtime:v2.3 stable at 2026-03-21T23:55:20Z. Logs: https://go/logs/rollout/1767552222
anna-w: Great work. If any post-rollout signals breach thresholds reopen this thread.
